description: An exact formal change of variables makes every normal order of the single-boundary determinant equation linear; the genuine nonlinearity lies in the Newton-support constraint.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: The formally invertible change W=M0/(AB), T=sW^(1/S), H=(alpha log(B/B0)-beta log(A/A0))/S converts the full single-component determinant equation into a linear equation in H and W and decouples all normal orders before support restrictions.
members.title: Exact Normal Coordinates Linearize Every Boundary Order

members.statement: For every r at least 5 in the full (8,28) windows, the terminal layer operator is injective; for 5 at most r at most 11 its cokernel has dimension r-1.
members.title: The Full (8,28) Terminal Layer Maps Are Injective

members.statement: Over an infinite characteristic-zero field, every finite jet of a formal two-variable Jacobian-one automorphism fixing the origin is matched by a polynomial Jacobian-one automorphism composed of linear SL2 maps and polynomial shears.
members.title: Every Finite Area-Preserving Jet Is Polynomially Realizable

members.statement: The exact layer replay identifies all fifteen archived normal-jet equations with filtered residue coordinates; the five layer-seven and six layer-eight tuples are complete pole-filtered frames, while the selected six equations are a decisive but not presently canonical coordinate projection.

source_treatment: The linked working manuscript has exact locations for every program-relevant defining claim on this page. This says where the claims are recorded, not that they have been independently verified.
statement: With \(W=M_0/(AB)\), \(T=sW^{1/S}\), and \(H=(\alpha\log(B/B_0)-\beta\log(A/A_0))/S\), the full determinant equation is equivalent to \((S\,d+d\log M_0\,T\partial_T)H=\omega(1-S^{-1}T\partial_T)(W-1)\). Hence the normal orders decouple before the triangular support equations are imposed.
title: Exact Normal Linearization at the Plane Boundary
